name: sysmon
description: GPU / CPU / RAM / disk panel: is the machine free, and what is loading it

language.title: Language
language.description: Display language of the panel (also settable for every mod at once with /langmod)

gpuBackend.title: GPU source
gpuBackend.description: auto: detect Jetson, then NVIDIA, then AMD; jetson and amd are not validated on real hardware yet

intervalSeconds.title: Refresh interval (s)
intervalSeconds.description: Measurement period while the panel is visible; nothing is measured while it is closed

vramAlertPercent.title: VRAM alert threshold (%)
vramAlertPercent.description: GPU memory use above which the GPU card turns red

tempAlertC.title: GPU temperature alert threshold (°C)
tempAlertC.description: GPU temperature above which the GPU card turns red

hideMissingGpu.title: Hide the GPU card when there is no GPU
hideMissingGpu.description: Without a supported GPU: hide the card instead of showing 'No supported GPU'

gpuIndex.title: GPU index
gpuIndex.description: Which GPU to follow on a multi-GPU machine (nvidia-smi -L / rocm-smi card index)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the panel in every session (otherwise: /sysmon)

diskPaths.title: Disks to watch
diskPaths.description: Comma-separated paths; a mount point shared by several paths is shown once

diskIntervalSeconds.title: Disk refresh interval (s)
diskIntervalSeconds.description: Disk space moves slowly: measured less often than the rest

diskAlertGb.title: Disk alert threshold (GB free)
diskAlertGb.description: Free space below which the disk card turns red
